Summary: Jason set out on a long journey with a single hope: to find a book capable of restoring his brother Tim’s soul. His search leads him to an ancient forest where the villagers avoid uttering certain names, the paths vanish into the fog, and those who venture too far in rarely return. As he tries to uncover the truth behind the legends, Jason catches the attention of a sorcerer obsessed with his own experiments and meets a mysterious hooded woman who seems to protect the forest’s secrets as much as she fears them. With time running out and enemies lurking in the shadows, Jason must decide who to trust before the forest claims another victim and his last chance to save Tim vanishes forever.

entry.title: Freeze
entry.summary:
Author: shihiro

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 3,754Chapters: 2/?Kudos: 4

Summary: Stephanie Brown begins every morning with a pen and a green notebook—a ritual she's kept for years, ever since there was someone on the other end. Now her days are filled with endless to-do lists and people who admire her quiet efficiency, unaware of the weight she still carries in her heart. Jason Todd returned from the dead only to find himself haunted by ghosts that refuse to stay buried. Caught between an old unsolved case and a silent promise, he's trying to carve out a place for himself in a Gotham that has learned to move on without him. In a world where soulmates are not an inevitable destiny but merely the beginning of a story, Steph and Jason's bond—built on childhood promises and shared dreams—was frozen in time by death. Now, years later, they must face their grief, heal the wounds they carry, and discover whether they can fall in love with the people they've become, rather than the memories they left behind.
